name: @teactjs/postgres
description: Postgres storage driver, session store and plugin for Teact — pg, postgres.js, Neon and PGlite

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target bun --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external @teactjs/core --external @teactjs/storage --external @teactjs/plugin-sdk --external pg --external postgres --external @neondatabase/serverless --external @electric-sql/pglite && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json && bun ../../scripts/fix-dts.ts
